nodes.label: Attendance lock rule (attendance_lock_days)
nodes.rationale: Lessons older than attendance_lock_days (default 3) are locked; edits need attendance.edit_past and are audited separately.

nodes.label: Auth design (JWT 15 min, refresh rotation, HMAC hash)
nodes.norm_label: auth design (jwt 15 min, refresh rotation, hmac hash)
nodes.rationale: Refresh token is 256-bit random stored as HMAC hash; reuse of a used refresh closes all sessions; state verified from DB each request.

nodes.label: Billing engine planCharges (pure function)
nodes.rationale: Pure function independent of DB, unit tested; charges generated on demand (no cron) before relevant actions.

nodes.label: FIFO payment allocation (AllocatorService)
nodes.rationale: Payments allocated to charges by due_date then period_start; unallocated remainder is advance; advance and open charges cannot coexist; per-student advisory lock serializes money ops.

nodes.label: Effective permission model (matrix, overrides, guards)
nodes.rationale: Effective permission = user_permissions override, else center_role_permissions, else deny; guard order JwtAuth, Roles, Permissions; matrix lives in packages/shared.

nodes.label: Roadmap: small backend gaps (center settings, plans, manual lock)
nodes.norm_label: roadmap: small backend gaps (center settings, plans, manual lock)

nodes.label: Dependency-free xlsx/csv parser (spreadsheet.ts)
nodes.rationale: Built without external libraries to avoid supply-chain risk and for budget; limits guard against ZIP bombs.

nodes.label: Append-only money and audit records
nodes.rationale: Payments, payouts, rating points and audit_logs have no DELETE; mistakes are corrected via reversal rows, preserving history.

nodes.label: Composite FK (id, center_id) pattern
nodes.rationale: The database itself rejects cross-center references; every new tenant table must follow it and be added to TENANT_TABLES, enforced by a meta-test.

nodes.label: Debt computed from charges, not stored
nodes.norm_label: debt computed from charges, not stored
nodes.rationale: Debt is the remaining balance of OPEN/PARTIAL charges past due_date plus grace_days; cancelled charges and advance are not debt.

nodes.label: Discounts apply only to future charges
nodes.norm_label: discounts apply only to future charges
nodes.rationale: Before granting or ending a discount, charges are generated up to now so past periods stay frozen at the old price; multiple discounts add up capped at base amount.

nodes.label: No cron / on-demand generation decision
nodes.rationale: Free hosting gives no guaranteed background process, so charges and notifications are computed on request or by external cron trigger.

nodes.label: RLS tenant isolation (erp_app role, withContext)
nodes.rationale: App connects as non-superuser, non-owner erp_app; each transaction sets app.center_id and app.is_super_admin via set_config; super admin flag only from verified JWT role.

nodes.label: Business date timezone Asia/Tashkent
nodes.rationale: All business dates use UTC+5 via common/dates.ts across services and tests.
